title: League
description: The ENTIRE league state in one object. This is the single save file the whole simulator reads and rewrites. Every engine module takes an object of this shape and returns an updated one. Sub-objects are defined in the sibling schemas (team/player/draft/history) and referenced here.

schemaVersion.description: Bump this and write a migration when you make a breaking change to the shape.

meta.description: League-wide clock and identity. The engine reads currentSeason/phase to know where in the yearly cycle it is.

currentSeason.description: The year currently being played / about to be played.

currentPhase.description: Where in the yearly cycle the league is. Modules advance this.

rngSeed.description: THE master seed. Every module derives a deterministic sub-stream from this. Same seed + same actions = same league, always.

settings.description: Tunable rules for this league. Change these to reshape the sim without touching code.

meetingsPerMatchup.description: How many times each pair of teams plays per season.

players.description: The MASTER list of all rostered players and free agents. A team's roster is derived by filtering on teamId. See player.schema.json.

freeAgents.description: Ids of players with no team, awaiting a contract. These ids also appear in `players` with teamId=null.

draft.description: Current draft class + order. See draft.schema.json.

capReport.description: Advisory, regenerated by updateContracts.js. Per-team committed salary and cap space. Safe to ignore or delete; it's a convenience cache, not source data.
